desc: Implement stdin parser + solution using the median-of-transformed-positions reduction (a_j = p_j - j), with trivial 0/1 case outputting 0, and print sum of absolute deviations from the median.
Verify the implemented solution on all three provided samples (3, 0, 7) and confirm it stays within O(N log N) for N up to 5e5.
Reduce the problem to matching ordered 1s to consecutive target slots and identify the median-of-(p_j - j) formula as the core reduction.
